# M1: Proposal

> On that night Ezra took me to a lavish vegan restaurant in London.
> He looked magnificent in his suit.
> He said I looked so beautiful in the pink and black dress he'd bought me.
> He was being genuine and correct of course.
> With my collar on full display, he stumbled over his words.
> It wasn't till later in the evening did I realise my life would be happily bonded to his from then on.

- Scene
    - Ezra and Emily sit and eat their candlelit dinner
    - Ezra goes to the W.C. psyching himself up as he sits on a toilet
    - Ezra returns to the table and proposes to Emily, she says yes
- Altered scene
    - Whilst sitting on the toilet a tentacle breaks through and drags Ezra into the pipes
    - He screams as his bones shatter, his whole body forced into the pipes below
    - Emily hears his screams, she rushes into the toilet only to see his head, hands, and feet crushed together before they descend with a crack and pop
